You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0216.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords=[]; names=[]
def atom(sym,name,pos,charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(sym); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); i=rw.AddAtom(a); names.append(name); coords.append(pos); return i
def bond(i,j,t=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,t)
# core coords
b0=atom('C','b0',(20,312,0)); b1=atom('C','b1',(125,252,0)); b2=atom('C','b2',(229,312,0)); b3=atom('C','b3',(229,432,0)); b4=atom('C','b4',(125,492,0)); b5=atom('C','b5',(20,432,0))
qt=atom('C','qt',(332,252,0)); ot=atom('O','Ot',(332,135,0)); c1=atom('C','c1',(436,312,0)); c2=atom('C','c2',(436,432,0)); qb=atom('C','qb',(332,492,0)); ob=atom('O','Ob',(332,610,0))
# OH benzene
obenz=atom('O','OHbenz',(125,585,0))
# fused ring
p1=atom('C','p1',(550,276,0)); p2=atom('C','p2',(622,372,0)); p3=atom('C','p3',(550,468,0))
# six ring right
r1=atom('C','r1',(600,166,0)); r2=atom('C','r2',(716,154,0)); r3=atom('C','r3',(787,252,0)); r4=atom('C','r4',(740,360,0))
# bonds benzene alternating
for i,j,t in [(b0,b1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(b1,b2,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(b2,b3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(b3,b4,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(b4,b5,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(b5,b0,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),
              (b2,qt,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(qt,ot,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(qt,c1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(c1,c2,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(c2,qb,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(qb,ob,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(qb,b3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(b3,b2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
              (b4,obenz,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
              (c1,p1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(p1,p2,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(p2,p3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(p3,c2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
              (p1,r1,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(r1,r2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(r2,r3,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(r3,r4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(r4,p2,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]: bond(i,j,t)
# diazo p3 = N+ = N-
nmid=atom('N','diazo_N',(566,535,0),+1); nend=atom('N','diazo_Nterminal',(602,610,0),-1)
bond(p3,nmid,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(nmid,nend,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
# acetoxy attachment
acet_centers={}
def acetate(center,label,posO,posC,posO2,posMe):
 o=atom('O',label+'_O',posO); ac=atom('C',label+'_C',posC); oc=atom('O',label+'_Ocarbonyl',posO2); me=atom('C',label+'_Me',posMe)
 bond(center,o); bond(o,ac); bond(ac,oc,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(ac,me)
 acet_centers[label]=(center,o)
 return o
# rough coords for substituents extend per sketch
or1=acetate(r1,'OAc1',(548,96,0),(485,30,0),(435,75,0),(465,-50,0))
or2=acetate(r2,'OAc2',(767,82,0),(828,25,0),(880,80,0),(846,-95,0))
or4=acetate(r4,'OAc4',(785,423,0),(846,480,0),(900,435,0),(850,560,0))
# methyl and OH at r3
me3=atom('C','Me_r3',(855,202,0)); oh3=atom('O','OH_r3',(866,294,0)); bond(r3,me3); bond(r3,oh3)
# wedge bonds centers -> substituents; stereo uses directed bond from begin to end
for center,sub,dir in [(r1,or1,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(r2,or2,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(r3,me3,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE),(r3,oh3,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH),(r4,or4,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)]:
 bo=rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(center,sub); bo.SetBondDir(dir)
m=rw.GetMol()
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y,z) in enumerate(coords): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(float(x),float(-y),float(z)))
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True,flagPossibleStereoCenters=True)
print('centers after dirs')
for i in [r1,r2,r3,r4]:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i); print(names[i],a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# check valence
try:
 Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
except Exception as e: print('sanitize fail',e); raise
# hydrogens and embed
mh=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=False)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=202416; params.useSmallRingTorsions=True; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params); print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 print('embed fail'); quit()
# labels after embedding
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mh,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in [r1,r2,r3,r4]:
 a=mh.GetAtomWithIdx(i); print('3d',names[i],a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(mh)
print('MMFF props',props is not None)
if props:
 print('opt',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,mmffVariant='MMFF94s',maxIters=1000))
# write xyz all H
conf=mh.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\nGenerated from mol_0216.png\n')
 for i,a in enumerate(mh.GetAtoms()):
  x,y,z=conf.GetAtomPosition(i)
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {x: .8f} {y: .8f} {z: .8f}\n')
print('wrote',mh.GetNumAtoms())
